name: Aisyah Rahman
bio:
Aisyah Rahman's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly. While studying accounting at the University of Malaya, she volunteered at a local go-karting track to earn extra money. Surrounded by the roar of engines and the passion of the teams, she became captivated. After graduating, she sought opportunities to combine her financial expertise with her newfound love for racing, landing a junior role at a small racing team before eventually joining Inter Europol Competition.

Aisyah takes a data-driven and pragmatic approach to her role as Finance Controller. She believes in meticulous planning and rigorous financial analysis to ensure the team's resources are allocated efficiently and effectively. She's known for her ability to identify potential risks and opportunities, providing valuable insights to the team's strategic decision-making. Aisyah's calm demeanor, even under the high-pressure environment of motorsport, sets her apart.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair, often pulled back into a neat ponytail.
physical.description: Aisyah is petite with an athletic build and always looks impeccably professional.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with financial projections and racing stats.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk, even at the track.
